source: Same executable in both modes; comparison isolates the old 8 ms polling gate. It is not a full old-vs-new Engine benchmark.

path.connection_type: P2P Direct (inspect candidate addresses for LAN/IPv4/IPv6)

result.scope: Same-machine synthetic sample -> production mailbox/sender -> real WebRTC DTLS/SCTP -> permission/sequence-checked receiver. 32 warmup samples excluded. Poll mode reproduces the former scheduling gate using the same optimized sender; it is not a run of the old full Engine. Excludes SDL physical acquisition, virtual driver, game, WAN, video/audio. Each sample must arrive; a timeout fails the command instead of disappearing from percentiles.
